open.why: D21 keeps lg, but no value is recorded. The draft's 20px contradicts D21, which maps the 20px call sites to xl.
The Figma draft's space/2xs to 3xl (2, 4, 8, 12, 16, 24, 32, 48px) is a second scale; D01 and D14 decide one 3px system. Not admitted. The draft's buttons and chip are bound to it.
metric 5, 7, 10, 14 and 20, the tooltip's 10, 11 and 13, the alert's 10 and 16, and the question inset 19 are decided or measured values off the 3px grid. Whether each stays off-grid is undecided.
metric, shape.radius, size.glyph, size.control, size.picker and size.dock are named after their values. Role names are owed.

rules: Raw values live only in this file. Every other file references tokens.
